# iDNES — Czech walkthrough, part 1

- Original source: [Robin Hood: 1. část průvodce hrou](https://www.idnes.cz/hry/robin-hood-1-cast-pruvodce-hrou.A021124_robinhoodlosnavod1_bw)
- Author / publication: Tomáš Krajča / iDNES.cz
- Language / date: Czech; 2002-12-08
- Access: Substantial indexed article text inspected; direct retrieval failed
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Krajča introduces general tactics and the first eight missions in his own campaign route. He explicitly treats the sequence as a personal route through a nonlinear game, rather than the only possible order or solution.

The advice emphasizes observing patrol movement and turning intervals, using maps, and taking shelter indoors. This makes the guide useful for comparing mission routes and stealth timing with the English walkthroughs.

Continue with [part 2](../guides/idnes-part-2.md). A [third installment](https://www.idnes.cz/hry/robin-hood-3-cast-pruvodce-hrou.A021208_robinhoodlosnavod3_bw) was located, but its body remains unreadable. The substantive search excerpts recovered in this pass improve the earlier title-only record; they do not amount to a full transcription or inspection of every illustrated step.
